skipped.reason: A bleed proc on crit — a damage-over-time source, not a stat, and the simulator has no DoT layer for physical specials.
An activated cooldown. Uptime depends on fight length and usage policy, neither of which this model has.
Stacking on-hit attack power. Needs a timeline to build stacks.

Extra targets. Single-target model.
A debuff on the target rather than a change to the player.

skipped.talent: Mace Specialization / Sword Specialization / Poleaxe Specialization
skipped.reason: Weapon-type gated, and the mace one is a stun proc. Would need per-weapon-type dispatch that nothing else needs yet.
Raises the crit damage bonus of abilities only. Real, but it belongs with the special-attack table rather than the white-swing modifiers this pass covers.
Grants expertise, which is a threat and hit-table term on the attacking side. The tank path scores survivability and never rolls the player's own attack table.
Raises block VALUE. The incoming-attack table models block as a chance and does not track how much a block absorbs, so there is nothing for this to change.

skipped.talent: Improved Heroic Strike / Improved Mortal Strike / Improved Whirlwind / Focused Rage / Improved Bloodrage
skipped.reason: Change abilities the Arms and Fury estimates use: Heroic Strike's rage cost (and every offensive ability's, for Focused Rage), Mortal Strike's and Whirlwind's cooldowns, Mortal Strike's damage and Bloodrage's rage. The estimate prices each at its base cost, cooldown, damage and rage; TalentModifiers has no per-ability field for them.

skipped.talent: Improved Rend / Improved Thunder Clap / Improved Overpower / Improved Cleave / Improved Slam
skipped.reason: Strengthen abilities neither Warrior DPS estimate casts: Rend, Thunder Clap, Overpower, Cleave and Slam.
Strengthen shouts. The Buffs tab carries Battle Shout at its untalented value and has no Demoralizing Shout on the boss.
Heal or grant rage when you are stunned or crit. A damage dealer has no incoming-damage stream here for either to trigger on.

skipped.talent: Last Stand / Improved Shield Block / Improved Shield Wall / Improved Defensive Stance
skipped.reason: Tank survival the tank estimate does not read: Last Stand and Shield Wall are cooldowns needing a usage policy, Shield Block's extra block needs a timeline, and the incoming-attack table has no spell damage for Improved Defensive Stance to reduce.

skipped.talent: Shield Slam / Devastate / One-Handed Weapon Specialization
skipped.reason: A tank's damage and threat. The tank estimate scores survival, and neither DPS estimate casts Shield Slam or Devastate or checks for a one-handed weapon.
Gated on the target being a humanoid, beast, giant or dragonkin. Nothing here models a mob type.
Grants armor penetration, which the engine genuinely does not read — it is the one stat still legitimately on the "not modelled" list.
Combo-point economy. Slice and Dice models a generation RATE now, but there is still no combo-point resource to add a point to, which is what both of these do.

skipped.talent: Adrenaline Rush / Blade Flurry / Cold Blood
skipped.reason: Activated cooldowns; uptime needs a usage policy this model has none of.

skipped.talent: Improved Eviscerate / Puncturing Wounds / Lethality / Aggression / Surprise Attacks / Opportunity
skipped.reason: Raise named abilities' damage, crit or crit damage. TalentModifiers has no per-ability field for them, so none applies, even where an estimate casts the ability: Combat's Sinister Strike, Assassination's Mutilate, Subtlety's Hemorrhage.
Teach or strengthen attacks no Rogue estimate makes: Riposte, Ghostly Strike and Ambush.

skipped.talent: Dagger Specialization / Mace Specialization / Sword Specialization / Fist Weapon Specialization
skipped.reason: Weapon-type gated, and the mace one adds a stun. Would need per-weapon-type dispatch, the same reason the Warrior specializations are refused.

skipped.talent: Improved Kidney Shot / Find Weakness / Dirty Deeds / Master of Subtlety / Shadowstep
skipped.reason: Windowed bonuses: while Kidney Shot holds, for 10 seconds after a finisher, below 35% health, from stealth, or after Shadowstep. Each needs a fight timeline.

Energy. Improved Sinister Strike lowers the cost of the Combat estimate's builder, which it prices at base cost; Vigor raises the energy cap, which a sustained energy rate never meets, so energy lost to capping is not modelled either.

Raises off-hand damage. Upstream writes it in talents.go in the same shape as the Warrior talent of the same name, which reaches offHandDamageMultiplier, so it is expressible; not yet ingested, because it moves every dual-wielding Rogue's estimate and wants its own check.

skipped.talent: Quick Recovery / Deadened Nerves / Lightning Reflexes / Deflection / Sleight of Hand / Heightened Senses / Enveloping Shadows / Cheat Death
skipped.reason: Survival: healing taken, damage taken, dodge, parry, and the chance to be hit or crit. A damage dealer has no incoming-damage stream here. Quick Recovery's other half refunds energy on a missed finisher, which the sustained rate does not price.
Strengthens Expose Armor, which the Buffs tab's target debuffs do not carry.

The hunter damage half is ingested. The other half is a per-spell crit bonus — 10% a rank on the pet Kill Command specifically, written as BonusCritRating on that one spell — and TalentModifiers has no field shaped like a spell, only fields shaped like an actor.
Activated cooldowns; uptime needs a usage policy this model has none of.

Multiplies Agility and Intellect. Expressible now that talents reach the stat pipeline; not yet ingested.
Raises the crit damage bonus of ranged attacks. Real, but it belongs with the crit-damage term rather than the white-damage multipliers this pass covers.
Grants attack power to the raid, not to the hunter. It is a raid buff wearing a talent costume.

skipped.talent: Master Tactician / Thrill of the Hunt / Readiness
skipped.reason: Procs and cooldowns needing a timeline.

skipped.reason: Teach or strengthen shots, strikes and traps no Hunter estimate makes. Every Hunter spec is modelled as Auto Shot and Steady Shot.
Gated on the target being a beast, giant, dragonkin or humanoid. Nothing here models a mob type.

skipped.reason: Ranged attack power from Intellect, a ranged attack power multiplier, +4% attack power, and +15% Agility. Upstream writes Careful Aim and Master Marksman in talents.go; Lightning Reflexes would be a stat factor, which that file does not write. None is ingested yet. Survival Instincts also cuts damage taken, which has no stream here.

skipped.talent: Endurance Training / Improved Aspect of the Monkey / Thick Hide / Spirit Bond / Catlike Reflexes / Deflection / Deterrence
skipped.reason: Survival for you and your pet: health, dodge, parry, armour and regeneration, and Deterrence is a cooldown. A damage dealer has no incoming-damage stream here.

skipped.talent: Improved Aspect of the Hawk / Go for the Throat
skipped.reason: Procs on ranged attacks: a haste aura, and Focus for the pet on a crit. The pet's Focus income is modelled from its regeneration alone.
Makes Hunter's Mark raise melee attack power too, and the Buffs tab's target debuffs do not carry Hunter's Mark.
Lowers the mana cost of shots. The Hunter estimate's mana figures price Steady Shot at its base cost.
Tank-facing armour, dodge and block. Expressible, but talents reach the damage path only.

skipped.talent: Elemental Fury / Concussion / Call of Thunder
skipped.reason: Spell-side talents with nowhere to attach: Elemental Fury raises spell *crit damage*, which has no field, and Concussion and Call of Thunder are scoped to named Nature spells, which TalentModifiers has no per-spell field for. (This used to say no spell school was recorded; abilities record one now, and Demonic Sacrifice, the one school-scoped talent ingested, reads it. The reason before that, that calculateCasterDps took no talents, stopped being true on 2026-08-19.)

Shamanistic Rage is an activated cooldown needing a usage policy. Stormstrike's strike is in Enhancement's rotation as a special attack; what is not modelled is the debuff it leaves, the next two Nature hits on the target taking 20% more.

skipped.talent: Call of Flame / Improved Lightning Shield / Lightning Mastery / Lightning Overload / Improved Healing Wave / Healing Way / Improved Chain Heal / Earth Shield
skipped.reason: Change particular spells (Fire totems, Lightning Shield, Lightning Bolt's cast time and its second bolt, Healing Wave, Chain Heal) or teach Earth Shield. TalentModifiers has no per-spell field for them, so none applies, even to Lightning Bolt and Chain Heal, which the Elemental and Restoration estimates cast.

skipped.talent: Unrelenting Storm / Ancestral Knowledge / Tidal Focus
skipped.reason: Mana the healer estimate tracks: regeneration from Intellect, maximum mana, and cheaper heals. Its mana figures price Chain Heal at base cost and read regeneration from MP5 and Spirit alone, and StatBlock has no Mana field. Upstream writes Unrelenting Storm and Ancestral Knowledge in talents.go.

skipped.talent: Elemental Devastation / Elemental Mastery / Nature's Swiftness
skipped.reason: Procs and cooldowns: melee crit after a spell crit, a guaranteed crit, an instant cast. Each needs a timeline.

skipped.talent: Elemental Warding / Elemental Shields / Spirit Weapons / Nature's Guardian
skipped.reason: Survival: damage taken, the chance to be crit, parry, and a heal at low health. A damage dealer or healer has no incoming-damage stream here.

Strengthens weapon imbues. Windfury Weapon is in the Enhancement estimate at its untalented value.
Spell power from attack power and from Intellect. Upstream writes both in talents.go, so they are expressible as stat conversions; not yet ingested.

Reduces the chance to be crit, which the damage path does not model.

Shapeshifts with party-wide effects; neither the form nor the party is modelled.
Proc-driven energy and combo points, needing a timeline.

TalentModifiers has no per-spell field for them, so none applies, even to Starfire, which the Balance estimate casts.

skipped.talent: Feral Aggression / Shredding Attacks / Savage Fury / Predatory Instincts / Mangle
skipped.reason: Change particular cat abilities (Ferocious Bite's damage, Shred's energy cost, Claw, Rake and Mangle's damage, crit damage in forms) or teach Mangle. The Feral estimate prices Shred and Rake at their base figures, takes no crit damage from talents, and casts neither Mangle nor Ferocious Bite.

skipped.talent: Improved Rejuvenation / Empowered Touch / Improved Regrowth / Swiftmend / Empowered Rejuvenation / Gift of Nature
skipped.reason: Strengthen particular heals (Rejuvenation, Healing Touch, Regrowth, heals over time) or teach Swiftmend; Gift of Nature raises all healing. None has a field: Empowered Rejuvenation reaches Lifebloom, which the Restoration estimate casts, and is still not applied, and there is no healing multiplier.
Mana regeneration from Intellect, which the healer estimate's mana figures do not read: they read MP5 and Spirit. Upstream writes it in talents.go; not yet ingested.

skipped.talent: Nature's Grace / Nature's Swiftness / Force of Nature
skipped.reason: A faster cast after a spell crit, an instant cast, and treants on a cooldown. Each needs a timeline, and nothing here models the treants.

skipped.talent: Feral Swiftness / Nurturing Instinct / Improved Leader of the Pack
skipped.reason: Survival: dodge in forms, healing taken, and a heal on crit. A damage dealer has no incoming-damage stream here, and Nurturing Instinct's healing from Agility is for heals no Feral estimate casts.
Strengthens Gift of the Wild, which the Buffs tab carries at its untalented value.
Multiplies Spirit. Upstream writes it in talents.go, so it is expressible as a stat factor; not yet ingested.
Damage-taken reduction; no incoming-damage stream on the damage path.
Proc-driven and aura damage multipliers that need a timeline or a party.
Gated on the target being a humanoid, demon, undead or elemental. No mob type here.
Paladin's raises block VALUE, unlike the Warrior talent of the same name which raises block CHANCE. The incoming-attack table tracks the chance only, so there is nothing here to change.

skipped.reason: Strengthen particular spells (Seal of Righteousness, Holy Light and Flash of Light, Exorcism and Holy Wrath, Holy spells' crit) or teach Holy Shock. TalentModifiers has no per-spell field for them, so none applies, even to Holy Light, which the Holy estimate casts.

skipped.talent: Illumination / Divine Favor / Light's Grace / Divine Illumination
skipped.reason: Procs and cooldowns: mana back on a heal crit, a guaranteed crit, a faster Holy Light, half-price spells. Each needs a timeline.

skipped.reason: Intellect, spell power from Intellect, Stamina, and expertise with Stamina. Upstream writes Divine Intellect, Sacred Duty and Combat Expertise in talents.go, so their stat factors are expressible; not yet ingested. Holy Guidance is not in that file. Combat Expertise's expertise is a tank's, which the tank estimate does not roll, as with Defiance.

skipped.talent: Improved Blessing of Wisdom / Improved Devotion Aura / Improved Blessing of Might / Improved Retribution Aura / Improved Sanctity Aura
skipped.reason: Strengthen blessings and auras. The Buffs tab carries them at their untalented values.

skipped.talent: Redoubt / Reckoning / One-Handed Weapon Specialization / Improved Holy Shield / Holy Shield / Ardent Defender / Avenger's Shield
skipped.reason: Tank procs, damage and threat. The tank estimate rolls a steady incoming-attack table with no timeline, so Redoubt's and Reckoning's procs, Holy Shield's charges and Ardent Defender's low-health window have nothing to run on, and it does not score a tank's damage.

skipped.talent: Improved Judgement / Fanaticism / Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
skipped.reason: Change Retribution's damage: Judgement's cooldown and crit, and +6% physical damage with a two-handed weapon. The estimate judges on the base 10-second cooldown. Upstream writes Two-Handed Weapon Specialization in talents.go as the same two-handed physical multiplier the Warrior talent of that name reaches, so it is expressible; not yet ingested, because it moves every Retribution estimate and wants its own check.

skipped.talent: Blessed Life / Pursuit of Justice / Eye for an Eye / Divine Purpose
skipped.reason: Survival, or damage returned when you are hit: half damage, spell hit taken, crits taken. A damage dealer or healer has no incoming-damage stream here.

Per-spell and school-scoped: Ignite is a burn left by Fire crits, Combustion a cooldown, and Winter's Chill a stacking debuff Frost spells keep up (the Buffs tab carries the debuff itself). Each needs a timeline or a per-spell field TalentModifiers does not have.

skipped.talent: Arcane Power / Presence of Mind / Icy Veins
skipped.reason: Timed cooldowns. A closed-form model has no timeline to place them on.
Raise one spell's coefficient; the generic cast profile has no per-spell coefficient to raise.

skipped.talent: Arcane Subtlety / Arcane Focus / Elemental Precision
skipped.reason: Hit and resistance scoped to schools: Arcane Focus is Arcane hit, Elemental Precision Fire and Frost hit (and cheaper Fire and Frost spells), Arcane Subtlety lowers the target's resistances. The spell hit field is character-wide, so an Arcane Mage would collect Elemental Precision's hit, and target resistances are not modelled. Upstream does not write them in talents.go.

skipped.talent: Critical Mass / Pyromaniac / Fire Power / Piercing Ice / Arctic Winds
skipped.reason: Fire and Frost crit and damage. A school damage multiplier exists (Demonic Sacrifice uses it), but upstream does not write these in talents.go, which is all this ingest reads, and school-scoped crit has no field. Arctic Winds also lowers the chance to be hit.
Raise spell crit damage, for all spells and for Frost spells. There is no crit-damage field for talents, the same gap as Elemental Fury.

skipped.talent: Arcane Impact / Empowered Arcane Missiles / Improved Fireball / Incineration / Improved Flamestrike / Improved Frostbolt / Improved Cone of Cold / Wand Specialization / Pyroblast / Blast Wave / Dragon's Breath / Summon Water Elemental
skipped.reason: Change particular spells (Arcane Blast's crit, Arcane Missiles, Fireball's and Frostbolt's cast time, Fire Blast, Scorch, Flamestrike, Cone of Cold, wands) or teach a spell or the Water Elemental. TalentModifiers has no per-spell field for them, so none applies, even to Arcane Blast, Fireball and Frostbolt, which the estimates cast; nothing here models the Water Elemental.

skipped.talent: Arcane Potency / Improved Scorch / Molten Fury
skipped.reason: Windowed bonuses: crit while Clearcasting, a stacking Fire vulnerability Scorch keeps up (no estimate casts Scorch, and the Buffs tab does not carry it), and damage below 20% health. Each needs a fight timeline.

skipped.talent: Magic Absorption / Arcane Fortitude / Improved Mana Shield / Improved Blink / Prismatic Cloak / Frost Warding / Frozen Core / Ice Barrier
skipped.reason: Survival: resistances, armour, damage taken, absorbs and the chance to be hit. A damage dealer has no incoming-damage stream here.
Stacking target debuffs applied by casting; they need a timeline and a debuff slot on the target.
Timed cooldowns, which a closed-form model has no timeline to place.
Per-spell coefficients; the healer path models one generic cast.

skipped.talent: Improved Power Word: Shield / Focused Power / Divine Fury / Searing Light / Surge of Light / Improved Shadow Word: Pain / Improved Mind Blast / Shadow Power / Reflective Shield / Wand Specialization / Holy Nova / Lightwell
skipped.reason: Change particular spells (Power Word: Shield, Smite and Mind Blast's hit, Smite, Holy Fire and the big heals' cast time, a free instant Smite after a crit, Shadow Word: Pain's duration, Mind Blast's cooldown and crit, wands) or teach Holy Nova or Lightwell. TalentModifiers has no per-spell field for them, so none applies, even to Shadow Word: Pain and Mind Blast, which the Shadow estimate casts.

skipped.talent: Holy Specialization / Shadow Focus / Darkness / Shadowform
skipped.reason: Scoped to a school: Holy crit, Shadow hit, Shadow damage. A school damage multiplier exists (Demonic Sacrifice uses it), but upstream does not write these in talents.go, which is all this ingest reads, and school-scoped hit and crit have no field. Shadowform also cuts physical damage taken.

skipped.talent: Mental Agility / Mental Strength / Holy Concentration
skipped.reason: Mana the healer estimates track: cheaper instant spells (Holy's Circle of Healing), maximum mana, and free heals after a proc (Discipline's Flash Heal). Their mana figures price each heal at base cost, StatBlock has no Mana field, and the proc needs a timeline. Upstream writes Mental Strength in talents.go.

skipped.talent: Enlightenment / Spirit of Redemption / Spiritual Healing
skipped.reason: Multiply Stamina, Intellect and Spirit, or Spirit alone, or raise all healing. Upstream writes Enlightenment and Spirit of Redemption in talents.go, so their stat factors are expressible; not yet ingested. There is no healing multiplier field.

skipped.talent: Improved Inner Fire / Focused Will / Spell Warding / Blessed Recovery / Blessed Resilience / Shadow Resilience / Pain Suppression
skipped.reason: Survival: armour, damage taken, heals after a crit, the chance to be crit, and Pain Suppression's cooldown. A damage dealer or healer has no incoming-damage stream here.

skipped.reason: Strengthen Prayer of Fortitude and Prayer of Spirit, which the Buffs tab carries at their untalented values.

skipped.reason: Stamina and Spirit factors, a stronger Fel Armor, and stronger Firestone and Spellstone. Upstream writes Demonic Embrace in talents.go, so it is expressible as a stat factor; not yet ingested. Fel Armor and the stones are not modelled.

skipped.reason: Survival: the chance to be crit, damage shared with the demon, immunity after a spell hit. A damage dealer has no incoming-damage stream here.
